'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
